text:
tara: quick QA on a new dark-theme variant for Console charts. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/lunar-ink. Things I noticed: micro-legend squares vanish at 16px, inline code looks greyed out, tooltip blur feels like a glass smear. attaching screenshots.
sam: saw that. darkest stop is too close to bg. options: lift the 0% stop or add a 1px inner stroke on swatches.
anya: prefer explicit legend ranges vs words. also add alt captions for exported PNGs (short mapping).
joy: accessibility notes: aim for 4.5:1 for small legend text. consider non-color encoding for the lowest bucket (stipple/hatch). keyboard focus must be obvious (3px ring).
contrast-bot: auto-check -> legend #98a7b6 on bg #061018 = 3.9:1. Recommend #cbdcef or semibold.
sam: tiny CSS demo for stroke + focus:
```
.legend-swatch{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);stroke-width:1}
.heatmap-cell:focus{outline:3px solid #2563eb}
```
tara: I'll prototype two frames in Figma: (A) lifted-dark + stroke, (B) continuous ramp + stipple for lowest bucket. running a quick PM A/B next week.
anya: also tweak tooltip opacity to 0.92 and bump text to 12px semibold.
joy: export checklist: SVGs need <title>/<desc>, PNGs need alt + caption (e.g., "Token frequency: 0-5% (hatched), 6-20% (indigo), 21-60% (teal), >60% (cyan)").
sam: poll: stroke (:+1:) or stipple (:-1:)?
contrast-bot: poll update -> stroke 5, stipple 2.
tara: thanks all, I'll post Figma links when ready and add tickets.
